response.overview: The 2026 Campeones Cup is an annual soccer showdown between the champions of Major League Soccer (MLS) and Liga MX. The one-match competition brings together the MLS Cup champion and the Liga MX Campeón de Campeones winner for a battle to claim continental bragging rights. The 2026 edition features Inter Miami CF vs. Cruz Azul at Nu Stadium in Miami, offering fans a high-profile clash between two of North America’s top clubs.
response.title: Campeones Cup 2026
